subject: general
question: In which state is the Madai Festival celebrated?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Chattisgarh__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Madai festiva**l is celebrated by people belonging to the** Gond community** with a lot of interest and excitement.
 
• A** goat is sacrificed **in honour of the tribal gods.
 
• This ritual takes place beneath a sacred tree.
 
• A procession of the local gods in which a large number of tribal people participate in the initiation ceremony of the festival.
